BRICS Summit Security Measures Impact Delhi Courts and Ghaziabad

Ahead of the 2026 BRICS Summit, security measures are being implemented in Delhi and Ghaziabad. In Delhi, Patiala House Courts may operate virtually due to anticipated security and traffic restrictions. The Delhi Traffic Police have prepared a plan to manage traffic around the Supreme Court and High Court, with bar associations reportedly agreeing to cooperate. In Ghaziabad, security has been heightened, including restrictions on drones and paragliders, with action threatened for any violations.
